package fixture

func good(c *gin.Context, code errcode.Code) {
	_ = Error{Error: ErrorError(errcode.InvalidInput)}
	_ = &RequestError{Code: errcode.NotFound}
	c.JSON(400, gin.H{"error": string(errcode.InvalidInput), "error_description": "a sentence"})
	_ = map[string]string{"error": string(code)}
	RespondWithError(c, 400, errcode.InvalidInput, "m")
	_ = Error{ErrorDescription: "literal description is fine"}
}

func typedHelper(c *gin.Context, code errcode.Code) {
	c.JSON(400, gin.H{"error": string(code)})
	_ = AuthError{Code: errcode.Unauthorized}
}
